scan_diagnostics.webull_quote_note: Shadow mode only: read-only Webull quotes are sampled and compared with Yahoo; they do not affect price selection, verification, scoring, BUY gates, or paper trades.
scan_diagnostics.massive_live_quote_note: Optional last-trade cross-check is disabled by default. Enable MASSIVE_LIVE_QUOTE_ENABLED=true only if the Massive Stocks plan includes /v2/last/trade; 15-minute delayed data is accepted only when its timestamp is within 45 minutes.

market_session.calendar_note: XNYS holidays and early closes are calendar-aware; extended-hours boundaries use the configured 04:00–20:00 ET window.

massive_fallback_policy.note: Massive fallback is capped to three requests per scan; remaining Yahoo failures use Stooq to avoid serial rate-limit waits.
